ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 90% high-intensity white pixels across the central fluke surface and 10% low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white pixel field covering the interior of both lobes. A high-contrast black border tracks the entire trailing edge, widening into dense irregular clusters at the far lateral tips (left and right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the outer distal margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged loss of trailing edge symmetry at the extreme lateral tips, particularly on the left lobe, showing concentrated low-intensity pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a singular, low-intensity focal point (dark speck) located in the lower-central region of the visible ventral surface.
